expectations.description: Silver and Gold row counts match.
expectations.query: SELECT abs((SELECT count(*) FROM lakehouse.silver.teaching_progress) - (SELECT count(*) FROM lakehouse.gold.teaching_progress_metrics))

expectations.description: Silver and Gold candidate key sets match in both directions.
expectations.query: SELECT count(*) FROM ((SELECT ma_lop_hoc_phan, nam_hoc, hoc_ky FROM lakehouse.silver.teaching_progress EXCEPT SELECT ma_lop_hoc_phan, nam_hoc, hoc_ky FROM lakehouse.gold.teaching_progress_metrics) UNION ALL (SELECT ma_lop_hoc_phan, nam_hoc, hoc_ky FROM lakehouse.gold.teaching_progress_metrics EXCEPT SELECT ma_lop_hoc_phan, nam_hoc, hoc_ky FROM lakehouse.silver.teaching_progress))

expectations.description: Progress values and lineage fields reconcile at the candidate grain.
expectations.query: SELECT count(*) FROM lakehouse.silver.teaching_progress s FULL OUTER JOIN lakehouse.gold.teaching_progress_metrics g ON s.ma_lop_hoc_phan = g.ma_lop_hoc_phan AND s.nam_hoc = g.nam_hoc AND s.hoc_ky = g.hoc_ky WHERE s.ma_lop_hoc_phan IS NULL OR g.ma_lop_hoc_phan IS NULL OR s.ma_ban_ghi <> g.source_record_id OR s.ty_le_tien_do_giang_day <> g.ty_le_tien_do_giang_day OR s._record_checksum <> g.source_record_checksum
